facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Sara Crewe lost everything after her father died without warning. She moved from a warm beautiful room to a small freezing cold attic. The other students laughed at her old dress and her servant's work. Miss Minchin expected Sara to feel ashamed and broken by her new life. But Sara walked through the school with her head held quietly high. She never begged for sympathy or complained about how unfair life was. She had something inside her that no change of fortune could ever reach. Dignity comes from within.
facts.Word cards: dignity = 품위 / within = 내면에서 / poverty = 가난 / taken away = 빼앗기다
